build.reason: The recipe runs Autotools and links $SRC/c-ares/.libs/libcares.a. The changed Automake target is in src/lib, and the updated repository test rules link src/lib/libcares.la. No step in the complete old recipe adjusts its archive path.

evidence.dependency_reason: The changed repository link rules confirm the library's relocated path.

input.reason: The entry passes an unsigned-long input length to parsers accepting int; the supplied packet does not establish a maximum input length for this target.

evidence.dependency_reason: The parser declaration gives the receiving length type.

lifecycle.reason: The entry initializes each result pointer, frees non-null host entries or data, and retains no parser result across calls.

evidence.dependency_reason: This is the host-entry cleanup called by the entry.
This is the reply-data cleanup called by the entry.

control_flow.reason: If built, the entry unconditionally calls its nine reply parsers on each input; the A and AAAA parsers delegate to the shared address-info parser.

evidence.dependency_reason: The A parser delegates to the shared parser and handles its status.
The AAAA parser follows the same route.

blockers.requirement: Link the fuzz target against the library archive generated by the changed Autotools build.
blockers.target_route: build.sh runs buildconf, configure and make all, then invokes $CXX to link ares_parse_reply_fuzzer against $SRC/c-ares/.libs/libcares.a.
blockers.failure_condition: The library target is now defined in src/lib, so a fresh changed-source build places its libtool archive under src/lib rather than at the top-level .libs path named in the old link command.
blockers.alternative_paths: The complete old build recipe gives no alternate archive, search directory, or fallback link command. The repository's updated test link rules use src/lib/libcares.la.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The changed Automake hierarchy enters the directory owning libcares.la.
